title: Filtered continuity of internal derived invariants for a profinite group
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] on the small coherent profinite site in [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $J$ be a profinite group, meaning a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group. Write $\mathcal A_J(R)$ for internal $R$-modules [sk-def-sfb-module-objects] with an $R$-linear action of $\underline J(S)=C(S,J)$ [def-sfb-condensed-action-module], and $\Gamma_{R,J}$ for the submodule fixed after every profinite base change. Use its ordinary total right derived functor [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus], and put $R^q\Gamma_{R,J}(N)=H^q(R\Gamma_{R,J}(N[0]))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every small filtered category $I$ (nonempty, with a common target for every finite diagram) and diagram $(N_i)_{i\in I}$ in $\mathcal A_J(R)$, forgetting the action creates its filtered colimit: its underlying module is the sheaf colimit, with the induced action. For every $q\geq0$ the canonical map
$$\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}R^q\Gamma_{R,J}(N_i)\longrightarrow R^q\Gamma_{R,J}(\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}N_i)$$
is an isomorphism of internal $R$-modules. The legs are exactly the maps induced by the original colimit coprojections. All indexing categories, profinite parameters and sheaves lie in the chosen compatible universes. No discreteness, finite generation, norm completeness, or bounded cohomological dimension is assumed.
